items.source: In this context, scope means the lifecycle of an instance, such as singleton, prototype, and so forth. Scopes provided out of the box in Spring may be referred to using the SCOPE_* constants available in the ConfigurableBeanFactory and WebApplicationContext interfaces.
items.translation: 在此上下文中，scope 指的是实例的生命周期，例如 singleton、prototype 等。Spring 内置提供的范围可以通过 ConfigurableBeanFactory 和 WebApplicationContext 接口中可用的 SCOPE_* 常量来引用。

items.source: When used as a method-level annotation in conjunction with @Bean, @Scope indicates the name of a scope to use for the instance returned from the method.
items.translation: 当与@Bean一起用作方法级注解时，@Scope指示用于从该方法返回的实例的作用域名称。

items.source: NOTE: @Scope annotations are only introspected on the concrete bean class (for annotated components) or the factory method (for @Bean methods). In contrast to XML bean definitions, there is no notion of bean definition inheritance, and inheritance hierarchies at the class level are irrelevant for metadata purposes.
items.translation: 注意：@Scope 注解仅在具体 Bean 类（针对已注解的组件）或工厂方法（针对@Bean 方法）上进行内省。与 XML Bean 定义不同，不存在 Bean 定义继承的概念，且类级别的继承层次结构在元数据方面无关紧要。

items.source: Defaults to an empty string ("") which implies SCOPE_SINGLETON.
items.translation: 默认为空字符串（""），这表示 SCOPE_SINGLETON。

items.source: To register additional custom scopes, see CustomScopeConfigurer.
items.translation: 要注册额外的自定义作用域，请参见 CustomScopeConfigurer。

items.source: Defaults to ScopedProxyMode.DEFAULT, which typically indicates that no scoped proxy should be created unless a different default has been configured at the component-scan instruction level.
items.translation: 默认为ScopedProxyMode.DEFAULT，这通常表示除非在组件扫描指令级别配置了不同的默认值，否则不应创建作用域代理。

items.source: Analogous to <aop:scoped-proxy/> support in Spring XML.
items.translation: 类似于 Spring XML 中的 `<aop:scoped-proxy/>` 支持。

items.source: Mark Fisher, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen

Specifies whether a component should be configured as a scoped proxy
and if so, whether the proxy should be interface-based or subclass-based.
items.translation: 指定是否应将组件配置为作用域代理，如果是，则指定代理是基于接口还是基于子类。

items.source: Specifies the name of the scope to use for the annotated component/bean.
items.translation: 指定用于注解的组件/Bean 的作用域名称。
